source_registry.retrieval_channel: Public first-party company page, opened during this run.
claims: BNY states that it now supports XRP and RLUSD custody on its Digital Asset Custody platform for eligible institutional clients.
BNY identifies itself as RLUSD's primary reserve custodian and says it has a custody relationship with Ripple Prime.
BNY and Ripple intend to explore direct RLUSD mint/redeem through BNY and support for tokenized assets issued on XRPL; these are future plans subject to approvals.
BNY, Ripple and C2FO are exploring a supply-chain/trade-finance initiative using approved receivables; exploration is not a live production facility.
BNY's release states RLUSD market capitalization was approximately $2.5 billion at the announcement.
limitations: No XRP or RLUSD customer custody balance was disclosed.
Custody support does not establish new purchases, net inflows, collateral utilization or XRP settlement volume.
Future mint/redeem and tokenized-asset plans are not represented as completed.

source_registry.retrieval_channel: Public first-party company page, opened during this run.
claims: SBI Holdings, Startale and BlackRock announced an MOU to explore connectivity between tokenized money-market funds and JPYSC.
The stated workstreams are technology/infrastructure, business/distribution and regulatory/market development.
The MOU is exploratory and does not announce a production settlement rail.
limitations: The announcement does not identify XRP as the settlement or bridge asset.
No XRP purchases, XRP collateral balances, XRPL transaction volumes or production launch were disclosed.
The SBI Holdings release and Startale release describe the same MOU and are not independent evidence of two separate partnerships.

source_registry.retrieval_channel: First-party SBI Holdings search-index result; page rendering was iframe-limited.

limitations: Shared membership in a multi-party standard does not establish a bilateral Coinbase-SBI commercial agreement.
The described JPYSC/OUSD work is exploratory and does not establish XRP use.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Institutional custody access can lower operational barriers for eligible clients and support later XRP/RLUSD use.
competing_hypotheses.evidence_for: BNY's first-party announcement confirms XRP and RLUSD custody support.
competing_hypotheses.evidence_against_or_missing: No customer balances, new XRP purchases, net inflows or actual collateral utilization were disclosed.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Tokenized MMF/JPYSC interoperability may create a separate yen-dollar institutional rail rather than an XRP bridge-asset use case.
competing_hypotheses.evidence_for: The SBI/Startale/BlackRock MOU names tokenized MMFs and JPYSC; SBI/Startale's OUSD interoperability is a separate exploratory initiative.
competing_hypotheses.evidence_against_or_missing: The MOU does not specify a production design or rule out later interoperability with other networks; it does not name XRP.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Conflicting Level-1 bid shares may reflect venue-specific liquidity conditions rather than a market-wide directional imbalance.
competing_hypotheses.evidence_for: Kraken Level-1 bid share is 26.65%; OKX is 80.21%, with different quote currencies and unsynchronized/stale timestamps.
competing_hypotheses.evidence_against_or_missing: No synchronized multi-level depth, cancellations, executions or venue-normalized flow data were captured.
